scope: Overall health-related conversation across Michigan communities; national policy scenarios carry no local county attribution.
method: Source-specific synthetic fixtures: fictional community posts, regional news outlines, six fictional policy hearing sessions, and weekly search-interest series. Source labels are not randomly assigned to the same text. No actual posts, testimony, search metrics, or patient data.

sourceRules.hearings: 36 excerpts from six explicitly fictional national policy sessions; no Corewell, provider-specific events, invented quotations, named public officials, or local county attribution.
sourceRules.trends: 1,664 weekly query/county observations. Each 13-week series peaks at 100. Sentiment is null and these rows are excluded from all sentiment averages and percentages.
sourceRules.events: 120 records per event: 12 fictional news outlines and 108 community reactions. No hearing or search-interest records are linked to these events.

events.label: Corewell ER staffing
events.title: A reported staffing change adds to the wider health conversation.
events.description: Corewell Health reportedly plans to outsource ER staffing at Troy, Grosse Pointe and Lenox to TeamHealth, a private equity-backed firm. Livonia was described as likely.
events.response: The reported Corewell ER staffing plan raises concerns about continuity, workload, and clinician autonomy.
events.note: Reported plan; not independently confirmed here. Publication date, not a verified implementation date. All linked rows are invented news outlines or community reactions.
